name: pi-telegram-stt
description: STT orchestrator extension for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Wraps the inbound voice/audio pipeline (downloads voice notes, runs STT via a peer-dep provider extension, sends a 🎙️ echo to the user, and feeds the transcript into the agent prompt). STT is delegated to a peer-dep provider extension (default: pi-openai-stt; the only one in the repo since v0.5.0) selected via extensions.pi-telegram-stt.stt_provider in telegram.json. The 🎙️ echo is one feature of this package, not its purpose — the package name is the scope (STT orchestration), not a single feature. The section is registered once per session so the in-Telegram menu buttons stay stable across hot-reloads. v0.6.0: renamed from pi-telegram-echo to pi-telegram-stt; the package's scope is STT, and echo is a feature within it.
